headline: NDA sweeps Andhra Pradesh local body polls as Indian markets head into Diwali Muhurat trading after a strong week, while Ukraine-Russia talks and Iran tensions loom abroad.

stories.title: NDA crushes YSRCP in Andhra ZPTC and MPTC elections
stories.summary: As of 9 p.m., TDP had won 229 ZPTCs and 4,823 MPTCs, JSP 36 and 644, BJP 8 and 130, while YSRCP had 20 and 1,050. TDP also wrested the Pulivendula ZPTC from YSRCP. Lokesh credited good governance.
stories.why_it_matters: A decisive verdict on Andhra Pradesh's ruling alliance, directly relevant to your home state's politics.

stories.title: Andhra Pradesh monsoon: two cyclones, ₹6,500 cr damage
stories.summary: Andhra swung from drought to deluge, with two back-to-back cyclones causing an estimated ₹6,500 cr in damage and at least 17 deaths. Crops were flattened, and Godavari belt farmers face at least two years of recovery.
stories.why_it_matters: Major economic and human toll in your home state.

stories.title: NDA dominates Kurnool, Nandyal; YSRCP fights back in Anantapur
stories.summary: The TDP-led alliance won 48 of 54 ZPTC seats in erstwhile combined Kurnool and nearly 90% of MPTC seats. In Anantapur, TDP won 175 MPTCs and led in 85 others.
stories.why_it_matters: Shows the regional spread of the NDA sweep in Rayalaseema.

stories.title: Cyclone Murasu: Naidu orders swift power restoration, price control
stories.summary: CM Naidu told officials to monitor field-level relief, complete damage assessments quickly and ensure prompt financial assistance to affected families.
stories.why_it_matters: Shows the state's relief response following the cyclone damage.

stories.title: Hyderabad illegal oocyte racket: agents booked, five fertility centres named
stories.summary: Agents have been booked and five fertility centres named in Hyderabad's illegal oocyte racket. The Telangana Women's Commission questioned the inaction.
stories.why_it_matters: A significant Hyderabad regulatory and law-enforcement story.

stories.title: 10 years since demonetisation: cash usage unchanged, fake notes rising
stories.summary: Ten years after the overnight demonetisation of 86% of cash, data shows cash usage is unchanged and fake notes are on the rise. Some stated aims remain largely unmet.
stories.why_it_matters: A decade-on assessment of a landmark economic policy.

stories.title: Godavari region: NDA wins MPTCs, recount protest at Korukonda
stories.summary: NDA won a large number of MPTC seats in the Godavari region. Former MLA Jakkampudi Raja staged a protest demanding a recount of Korukonda ZPTC votes, and tension prevailed.
stories.why_it_matters: Flags a contested result in a politically sensitive area of Andhra.

stories.title: Shamshabad–Kodangal radial road to be done by Dec 2027
stories.summary: The Telangana CM said the radial road from Shamshabad to Kodangal will be completed by December 2027.
stories.why_it_matters: Infrastructure timeline around Hyderabad.

stories.title: Lawrence Bishnoi gang member Hari Boxer detained in US
stories.summary: Rajasthan's AGTF secured the detention through coordination with the CBI and Interpol. Extradition proceedings are underway.
stories.why_it_matters: Notable cross-border law enforcement action.

stories.title: Russian strikes hit Ukraine's power grid ahead of Abu Dhabi talks
stories.summary: Russian strikes wounded nine and damaged Ukraine's power network. Ukrainian and Russian delegations are due for trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi next week.
stories.why_it_matters: The key conflict to watch, with talks imminent and implications for commodities and trade.

stories.title: US launches task force against Iran's land supply routes
stories.summary: The operation aims to stop Iran using ground routes to move weapons and materials. Separately, the US is offering $20m for information on Iran's nuclear programme.
stories.why_it_matters: Signals escalating US-Iran tension with Middle East and oil implications.

stories.title: Israel's president tasks Eisenkot with forming government
stories.summary: Neither Netanyahu's bloc nor his rival's secured a majority in last week's election, so the president asked opposition leader Eisenkot to try forming a government.
stories.why_it_matters: Could reshape Israeli politics and the region.

stories.title: Krakow shooting kills six; Tusk calls it terrorism
stories.summary: Six people were killed in a random shooting in Krakow's main square, and three more bodies were found at the attacker's home. Polish PM Tusk called it an act of terrorism.
stories.why_it_matters: Major attack in Europe.

stories.title: Houthis say Saudi air strike killed at least 33
stories.summary: The Houthis claim a Saudi air strike killed at least 33. Saudi Arabia has not commented.
stories.why_it_matters: Renewed Yemen violence adds to regional instability.

stories.title: US midterms: Democrats' win reshapes politics
stories.summary: Commentary points to a decisive rejection of Trumpism in the midterms, and to Republican cracks over Israel support after JD Vance's response to the defeat. Indian-American wins may also test India's MEA.
stories.why_it_matters: US political shifts affect trade, tech policy and India relations.

stories.title: Magnitude 5.7 quake hits central Japan
stories.summary: The quake in Shizuoka prefecture injured more than 20 people. Authorities warn of possible strong aftershocks.
stories.why_it_matters: Natural disaster with ongoing aftershock risk.

stories.title: Muhurat trading today as Nifty rallies seven sessions
stories.summary: Markets hold the Diwali special session today from 2:20 to 3:30 pm. Nifty rose for seven straight sessions and gained 8.58% last week on foreign buying and domestic liquidity, despite volatility in global AI and semiconductor stocks.
stories.why_it_matters: Sets the tone for Samvat 2083 after a strong week.

stories.title: Nifty, Sensex log worst Samvat returns in 15 years
stories.summary: Benchmarks posted their weakest Samvat returns in 15 years. An expert says the next sustainable rally must come from earnings growth rather than liquidity or valuation expansion.
stories.why_it_matters: Useful context for a long-term index investor.

stories.title: World Gold Council: gold near interim bottom
stories.summary: The WGC says gold may be nearing an interim bottom, with three historical conditions for a price recovery already in place.
stories.why_it_matters: Relevant for asset-allocation perspective.

stories.title: Wheat falls to lowest since June ahead of peace talks
stories.summary: Wheat futures touched their lowest since end-June as traders anticipate US-led talks with Ukrainian and Russian delegations.
stories.why_it_matters: Shows markets pricing in Black Sea peace prospects.

stories.title: 8th Pay Commission completes one year
stories.summary: The commission completed one year on 3 November, with about six months left before its expected report. Salary calculations at various fitment factors are being discussed.
stories.why_it_matters: Pending policy affecting central government pay.

stories.title: METR report: Anthropic using AI to automate AI development
stories.summary: METR's 11-week investigation found Anthropic's models improving roughly twice as quickly as a year ago, with little sign of slowing. Researchers are alarmed.
stories.why_it_matters: Signals accelerating capability progress that shapes AI engineering careers.

stories.title: Claude Code 'Don't Ask Again' exposed passwords in 1,122 GitHub files
stories.summary: Apiiro found coding-agent behaviour leaking secrets into public GitHub files, with 1,122 files affected.
stories.why_it_matters: A practical security lesson for anyone building or using coding agents.

stories.title: US let Nvidia sell chips to an empty office in China
stories.summary: The NYT reports New Matrix is on the approved list for H200 chips yet its offices are empty. Concerns are being raised about vetting by Commerce and Nvidia.
stories.why_it_matters: Export-control enforcement affects the AI chip supply landscape.

stories.title: MaxxBench questions DeepSWE scores
stories.summary: A new benchmark effort examines whether headline DeepSWE scores hold up.
stories.why_it_matters: Benchmark credibility matters when evaluating coding models and agents.

stories.title: Cloudflare scales D1 control plane to millions of databases
stories.summary: Cloudflare redesigned the D1 control plane to avoid centralized bottlenecks, using retries, idempotency and eventual consistency.
stories.why_it_matters: A good distributed-systems design write-up relevant to backend interviews.

stories.title: Grab handles surge in AI-generated code changes
stories.summary: Grab uses a layered defense to prevent, detect and contain crashes as AI assistants increase code changes per release.
stories.why_it_matters: Real-world practice on AI-era release stability.

stories.title: pg_vectorsearch brings PRISM index to PostgreSQL
stories.summary: Tiger Data's alpha extension uses partitioning and compression instead of HNSW graphs, cutting memory use and index build times.
stories.why_it_matters: Relevant for vector search in RAG systems on Postgres.

stories.title: Microsoft Research's AI Frontiers group ends
stories.summary: Reports say the group has been wound down, drawing heavy discussion on Hacker News.
stories.why_it_matters: Signals shifts in big-tech AI research investment.

stories.title: India go 2-0 up in NZ ODIs after narrow DLS win
stories.summary: In a low-scoring second ODI, 15 wickets fell to quicks and only 247 runs were scored. India won by DLS in a seam-friendly contest.
stories.why_it_matters: India leads the series 2-0.

stories.title: MI set to trade Hardik to PBKS for Arshdeep
stories.summary: Once the trade goes through, Mumbai Indians will have a new captain for IPL 2027.
stories.why_it_matters: Major IPL 2027 shakeup.

stories.title: Tilak, Jurel, Prasidh shine for India A; Bumrah bowls in whites
stories.summary: Bumrah returned to bowling in whites but was wicketless in a six-over spell.
stories.why_it_matters: Bumrah's red-ball comeback progress.
